2607.05251.title: Privacy-Preserving Robustness Verification for Neural Networks
2607.05251.paper_summary: Neural network verification and data privacy are inherently in tension: verification demands full access to model parameters and input data, yet both are increasingly restricted by privacy regulations and intellectual property constraints. This tension has left robustness verification impractical in privacy-sensitive domains. In this work, we address this gap with SecureCROWN, the first framework for privacy-preserving neural network robustness verification. Built upon secure two-party computation (2PC), our framework enables a model owner and a data owner to jointly compute certified robustness bounds -- revealing only the final result while provably protecting both parties' private data under the semi-honest security model. A key challenge is securely computing the conditional operations in Linear Bound Propagation, where the data-dependent branching is incompatible with standard secure computation protocols. We eliminate branching by formulating conditional logic as continuous arithmetic operations. Additionally, we introduce a Newton--Raphson refinement method to improve numerical stability. Extensive analysis and experiments show that SecureCROWN strictly matches plaintext verification results, while completing in 0.1--200s across varied model sizes and communication settings (LAN/WAN), demonstrating the feasibility of privacy-preserving neural network verification.
2607.05251.paper_summary_zh: 神經網絡驗證和數據隱私本質上是緊張的：驗證需要完全訪問模型參數和輸入數據，然而這兩者都受到隱私法規和知識產權限制的日益約束。這種緊張使得在隱私敏感領域進行穩健性驗證變得不切實際。在這項工作中，我們通過SecureCROWN來解決這一差距，這是首個用於隱私保護的神經網絡穩健性驗證框架。基於安全的雙方計算（2PC），我們的框架使模型擁有者和數據擁有者能夠共同計算經認證的穩健性界限——僅揭示最終結果，同時在半誠實安全模型下可證明地保護雙方的私有數據。一個關鍵挑戰是在線性界限傳播中安全計算條件操作，其中依賴於數據的分支與標準安全計算協議不兼容。我們通過將條件邏輯表述為連續算術運算來消除分支。此外，我們引入了一種牛頓-拉夫森精煉方法來提高數值穩定性。廣泛的分析和實驗表明，SecureCROWN嚴格匹配明文驗證結果，同時在不同模型大小和通信設置（LAN/WAN）下完成所需時間為0.1至200秒，展示了隱私保護神經網絡驗證的可行性。
